strings.jp: 「わしは ながらく{n} このあたりに すんでいる{n} きっちょむ と もうします！」{wait}{n}「旅人で にぎやかだった{n} このへんも 鬼のせいで{n} すっかり さびれてしまって！」{wait}{n}「おかげで 南から とりよせる{n} 食べ物も さっぱり とどかない{n} しまつです！」{wait}{n}「桃太郎さん！」{n}{n}{wait}{n}「どうか {col0}タマゴ{col0}を{n} 一つ ごちそうして{n} くれませんか？」{wait}{n}「お礼は{n} かならず いたします！」{n}{wait}
strings.en: "I am called Kitchomu, and I have lived around here for a long time!"{wait}"This area used to bustle with travelers, but thanks to the oni it's become completely deserted!"{wait}"Because of that, the food we order from the south doesn't get here at all!"{wait}"Momotaro-san!"{wait}"Would you please treat me to just one {col0}Egg{col0}?"{wait}"I'll be sure to repay you!"{wait}

Thank you!"{wait}"Let me give you a token of my thanks right away!"{wait}"I'm sure it'll be useful to you, Momotaro-san!"{wait}Momotaro got the {col4}Grappling Hook{col0}!{c19}{wait}"With this Grappling Hook, you can climb the Ice Tower!"{wait}"But the first floor of the Ice Tower is locked, so you can't get in!"{wait}"Rumor has it the Ice Cave near the tower leads to the tower's basement!"{wait}"They say there are strong oni in the Ice Tower and the Ice Cave, so please be careful!"{wait}
